name: Polynomials
overview: A polynomial of degree 2 is called a quadratic polynomial. This also means that a polynomial of degree 2 has atmost two zeroes. In other words, any polynomial of degree 3 can have at most three zeroes.

saq.answer: 3.2.1 Degree of a Polynomial Recall that if p(x) is a polynomial in x, the highest power of x in p(x) is called the degree of the polynomial p(x). A polynomial of degree 2 is called a quadratic polynomial.
